stories.title: Enrollment Status Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define canonical schema for clinical trial enrollment status including normalized values (RECRUITING, ACTIVE, COMPLETED, UNKNOWN), raw source field mapping from ClinicalTrials.gov, and validation contract for downstream consumers.

stories.title: Enrollment Status Extraction and Normalization Logic
stories.description: Implement core logic to extract enrollment status from ClinicalTrials.gov API response and normalize into defined categories (recruiting, active, completed). Handle missing or ambiguous statuses with fallback to UNKNOWN.

stories.title: Enrollment Status Integration in EvaluateCare Facade
stories.description: Integrate normalized enrollment status into Evaluate Care response payload so that clinical trial results include status alongside trial metadata for downstream rendering.

stories.title: Enrollment Status API Contract Exposure
stories.description: Ensure enrollment status field is exposed through FastAPI response models and tool responses, maintaining compatibility with existing tool_router and chat response structure.

stories.title: Enrollment Status Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create unit tests for status normalization logic and integration tests validating presence and correctness of enrollment status in clinical trial responses returned through Evaluate Care flows.
